quantity: static B3 (zincblende) -> B1 (rocksalt) transition pressure of SiC
code: Quantum ESPRESSO pw.x 7.5 (conda-forge qe-7.5-hc91ee90_1) through ASE
labelling: computed with DFT-PBE in this project: a model value (PBE), never a measurement

literature.source: Y. Xie, J. Vandermause, S. Ramakers, N. H. Protik, A. Johansson, B. Kozinsky, npj Comput. Mater. (2023), arXiv:2203.03824v2 pp. 7-8, Fig. 2b (DFT-PBE enthalpy crossing)
Y. Kidokoro, K. Umemoto, K. Hirose, Y. Ohishi, Am. Mineral. 102, 2230 (2017), static GGA (LDA 63 GPa; 65/61 GPa with zero-point energy)
M. Yoshida et al., Phys. Rev. B 48, 10587 (1993)

records.name: phase_transition_pressure

method.name: DFT static enthalpy crossing, zincblende (B3) -> rocksalt (B1)
method.description: pw.x, PBE, SSSP_1.3.0_PBE_efficiency, ecutwfc 70 Ry / ecutrho 560 Ry, k-mesh (12, 12, 12) offset (0, 0, 0), gaussian smearing 0.01 Ry, conv_thr 1e-11 Ry/atom; E(V) of both 2-atom phases on one 12x12x12 mesh, Birch finite-strain fits (BM4 adopted), H = E + PV
assumptions: 0 K static lattice (no zero-point or thermal effects)
static lattice: no zero-point or thermal free energy (they lower P_t by a few GPa)
no kinetics: the equilibrium crossing, not the pressure at which a crystal transforms

uncertainty.description: BM4 vs BM3 fit of the same E(V) data

evidence.description: published value of the same functional: 65 GPa; tolerance 10.0 % (spread expected between PBE implementations, pseudopotentials and protocols). functional of the reference: PBE
evidence.citation: Y. Xie, J. Vandermause, S. Ramakers, N. H. Protik, A. Johansson, B. Kozinsky, npj Comput. Mater. (2023), arXiv:2203.03824v2 pp. 7-8, Fig. 2b (DFT-PBE enthalpy crossing)

checks.name: fit_pressure_vs_stress
